subject: general
question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 28 and 840, respectively. If one of the numbers is 168, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of **H.C.F.** and **L.C.M.** = Product of the **two numbers**.

Other number = (**H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**) ÷ **Given number**

Other number = (28 × 840) ÷ 168 = 840 ÷ 6 = 140.

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 28

**L.C.M.** = 840

**First Number** (n₁) = 168

**Formula Used:**

n₁ × n₂ = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f4137053b6b3fee7ae3ed75d33634fd2160316fc4552011b76698c82948f99d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 168 × n₂ = 28 × 840

⇒ n₂ = (28 × 840) ÷ 168

⇒ n₂ = 23520 ÷ 168

⇒ n₂ = 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

H.C.F. (Highest Common Factor)

It is the greatest number which divides each of the two or more given numbers exactly.

L.C.M. (Least Common Multiple)

It is the smallest number which is exactly divisible by each of the given numbers.

H.C.F. and L.C.M. of Fractions

H.C.F. = (H.C.F. of Numerators) ÷ (L.C.M. of Denominators) | L.C.M. = (L.C.M. of Numerators) ÷ (H.C.F. of Denominators).</p
